messages:
anne.p: quick sync — thinking through packaging tradeoffs for the next pricing launch. proposing 3 tiers (Starter / Pro / Enterprise) + explicit add-ons for Dedicated capacity and Extended Retention. want to surface the biggest negotiation levers + constraints. :thinking:

jason.s: +1. can we make Dedicated an add-on or a separate commitment SKU? sales prefers separate SKU so we can upsell with clear renewal terms.

anne.p: leaning separate SKU for predictability. risk is complexity on the self-serve funnel. idea: separate Dedicated SKU for sales-assisted flows, and a simpler "Burst Pack" add-on for self-serve.

li.k: from DX perspective, add-on gating is ok if SDK + console flows are 2-click. need clear defaults for quotas. self-serve should not require contract signing.

maria.f: finance question — if Dedicated is separate SKU with multi-month commits, we need to model ARR recognition and potential bill credits for misses. also how do we handle partial-month capacity reduction?

anne.p: good point. propose: monthly billing for Starter/Pro; quarterly or annual for Dedicated commit. partial-month: prorate credits only for force majeure or agreed deprovisioning window.

jason.s: customers will ask for soft caps/overages on Dedicated. prefer a burst buffer + overage rate vs hard cap. pricing example: committed GPU hours + burst pool charged at 2.5x list.

li.k: operationally we can support a burst pool with throttles. need control plane flags:
```
feature_flags:
  dedicated_burst: true
  burst_overage_rate: 2.5
  soft_cap_pct: 120
```

anne.p: love the config snippet. we should add an SLA clause: when burst used, latency SLO is best-effort; core commit retains SLO. that helps legal.

maria.f: also add termination & migration terms for Private deployments. revenue recognition requires clear handoff windows.

jason.s: negotiation advice: offer a 10% discount for annual commit + 3-month early termination penalty. include 30-day burst credits for onboarding. customers love onboarding credits.

li.k: small UX ask: when a customer upgrades to Dedicated, console must show estimated monthly cost change and expected latency improvements. simple chart.

anne.p: note for roadmap: implement billing estimator widget (scope: console, SDK pricing endpoint, and email quote generator). acceptance: shows delta, commit term options, burst toggle.

maria.f: FYI: need to validate with accounting on deferred revenue for credits. I'll spin up a short doc with scenarios and numbers.

jason.s: one more thing — negotiation levers matrix for AE playbook. list common asks and our responses (e.g., lower price vs longer commit vs reduced SLA).

anne.p: agreed. i'll draft the matrix. action items:
- anne.p: draft pricing tiers + dedicated SKU proposal + SLA language (due EOD Fri)
- maria.f: modeling scenarios for ARR/credits (due Mon)
- li.k: spec UX flow + console estimator mock (due Wed)
- jason.s: start AE playbook skeleton and capture common asks from latest deals (ongoing)

ops-bot: note: created #pricing-roadmap Google doc at https://docs.internal/pricing-roadmap (access: product + finance + sales).

jason.s: thanks — will add 3 deal examples.

li.k: quick Q — do we want tier limits on embeddings (per-month vector units) distinct from token quotas? some customers want separate embedding buckets.

anne.p: yes, separate buckets makes sense. Starter: 10k embed units/mo, Pro: 100k, Enterprise: custom. treat embeddings as first-class meter.

maria.f: final: watch out for revenue leakage if embeddings billed differently; need clear invoice line items.

anne.p: cool. i'll include invoice line item examples in the doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
